nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK); Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Instituto Butantan; LSHTM; Erasmus MC; ITM Antwerp; Universidad del Valle; Swiss TPH
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 consortium researching Zika virus complications and building a sustainable Latin American research network for emerging-disease preparedness. NPHI-type partners include Fiocruz, Cuba's IPK and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: ZNPHI – International Vaccine Institute MoU on vaccine manufacturing
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (IVI, Seoul)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Lusaka in September 2025 to build Zambia's capacity across the vaccine and therapeutics value chain, from pre-clinical development to manufacturing and market access.

nphi.title: KDCA–Mongolia laboratory capacity cooperation
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.summary: Building Mongolia's national laboratory capacity, joint training on emerging infectious diseases and provision of quarantine supplies.

nphi.title: KDCA support to Africa CDC
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: Africa CDC; International Vaccine Institute
nphi.summary: Supports Africa CDC's crisis response, infectious disease diagnosis and capacity building in laboratory specimen transport and management. Africa CDC, IVI and KDCA also announced a vaccine-access and health-security partnership at the…

nphi.title: ICMR – Institute for Basic Science (Korea) MoU
nphi.with: Institute for Basic Science (IBS), Ministry of Science and ICT
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and Korea's Institute for Basic Science on cooperation in basic and health research.

nphi.title: China CDC – KDCA memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Seoul in December 2023, renewing an earlier agreement and covering 11 areas incl. infectious disease control, chronic disease monitoring and public health emergency response, plus joint global health work.

nphi.title: Tanzania–Korea project to strengthen public laboratories against infectious diseases
nphi.with: National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL) Tanzania; Ministry of Health Tanzania
nphi.summary: Five-year KOFIH-funded project with Tanzania's National Public Health Laboratory providing lab infrastructure and diagnostics for dengue, chikungunya, respiratory illness and, from year three, cholera.

nphi.title: China CDC – KDCA memorandum of understanding (renewed 2023)
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Seoul in December 2023, continuing an earlier edition. It covers 11 areas, including communicable and non-communicable disease surveillance, prevention and control, and emergency preparedness, plus new chronic-disease…

nphi.title: KDCA – Mongolia MoH MoU on pandemic preparedness (2024)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: Mongolia Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: MoU of 15 Feb 2024 on surveillance, lab capacity, a national public health plan and a Mongolian CDC; backed by a 7.2 billion won ODA programme for 2023–2027.

nphi.title: KOICA–US CDC Ghana Global Health Security Agenda Phase II (US$10.85 million)
nphi.with: KOICA; Ghana Health Service / Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: Second phase (2023–2027) strengthening laboratories, surveillance, emergency response and workforce in Ghana; phase one (2018–2023) trained over 100 epidemiologists.

nphi.title: WHO – China CDC training on intelligent public health and open-source epidemic intelligence (EIOS)
nphi.with: World Health Organization (EIOS); delegates from WHO Western Pacific Region member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's Global Public Health Center and WHO hold a yearly training for Western Pacific public health staff on EIOS open-source epidemic intelligence, multi-source surveillance data and rapid risk assessment. The 2025 round, the third,…

nphi.title: SHEPERD – Strengthening Health Emergencies Preparedness and Enhancing Response to Disease Outbreaks
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: Lao Ministry of Health (Dept. of Communicable Disease Control; National Centre for Laboratory and Epidemiology); Hanyang University College of Medicine
nphi.summary: KDCA-funded bilateral ODA that builds Lao laboratory systems and hospital-based surveillance for acute febrile illness and gastroenteritis. In 2026 it held the first Korea–Laos MERS tabletop exercise.

nphi.title: KDCA support to ASEAN infectious disease early warning and risk assessment
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Funds and supports the operation of an ASEAN regional system for infectious disease early warning and risk assessment.

nphi.title: KDCA–IVI epidemiologist fellowship (MoU 2022)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (EPIC unit)
nphi.summary: After a 2022 MoU and letter of intent, two KDCA epidemiologists join IVI's EPIC unit every four months; 14 had completed it by Dec 2024, working on field projects in Ghana, DR Congo and Madagascar.

nphi.title: AHRI–IVI Collaborating Center for vaccine research and training
nphi.with: Armauer Hansen Research Institute (AHRI)
nphi.summary: Launched in 2022 as IVI's third collaborating centre; covers vaccine research, surveillance, vaccinology training and cholera vaccination support in Ethiopia.

nphi.title: Uganda–Korea project to strengthen laboratory systems and infectious disease prevention, detection and response
nphi.with: Uganda Ministry of Health – National Health Laboratory and Diagnostic Services; Uganda National Institute of Public Health; National Public Health Emergency Operations Centre
nphi.summary: USD 8 million project (2022–2026) in Central and Southern Uganda supporting laboratory accreditation, turnaround times, point-of-care testing, digital data systems for mpox and VHF, specimen tracking and training in Korea.

nphi.title: ECDC – KDCA memorandum of understanding
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: MoU to deepen technical collaboration on communicable disease control and health security, covering epidemic intelligence, preparedness, surveillance, AMR, zoonoses and training through information and expert exchange.

nphi.title: KOICA–Peru project on SIS digitalisation and telemedicine
nphi.with: Ministerio de Salud del Perú; Seguro Integral de Salud (SIS); APCI
nphi.summary: US$7 million Korean grant agreed in 2021 to digitise Peru's public health insurance management and build the 'Tele atiendo' telemedicine platform, piloted in 300 public health centres, to run until 2026.

nphi.title: KDCA – US CDC memorandum of understanding (2019, renewed 2024)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.summary: Bilateral MoU between the Korean and US disease control agencies, signed in October 2019 and renewed in September 2024.

nphi.title: CAPTURA – Capturing data on AMR patterns and trends in use in regions of Asia
nphi.with: CAPTURA consortium; Fleming Fund (UK aid); national AMR surveillance sites
nphi.summary: Fleming Fund regional grant, run from IVI's platform since 2019, that gathers historical AMR and antimicrobial-use data and trains national teams on prescribing surveys, WHONET analysis and surveillance monitoring.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR – IVI tripartite MoU
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (IVI)
nphi.summary: Tripartite MoU (2017) plus Expression of Interest (2020) on vaccine research and development.

nphi.title: ASEAN+3 Field Epidemiology Training Network (ASEAN+3 FETN)
nphi.actor: Ministry of Public Health, Thailand (Department of Disease Control)
nphi.with: FETP programmes of ASEAN Member States and China, Japan, Korea; ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Regional network linking field epidemiology training programmes across ASEAN and China, Japan and Korea, set up in Bangkok in 2011 with Thailand's Ministry of Public Health endorsed as focal point.

nphi.title: SEAOHUN – Southeast Asia One Health University Network
nphi.actor: Southeast Asia One Health University Network (SEAOHUN), Chiang Mai University
nphi.with: 67 universities in national One Health university networks; USAID; KOICA; US Department of State
nphi.summary: Regional university network founded in 2011, with its secretariat at Chiang Mai University, that builds the One Health workforce through curricula, exchanges, fellowships and joint projects in Southeast Asia.

nphi.title: KDCA support to WHO Western Pacific Region infectious disease capacity
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: WHO Western Pacific Regional Office (Manila)
nphi.summary: Long-running KDCA ODA contribution to WHO WPRO to build regional capacity for infectious disease prevention, response and management.

nphi.title: China–Japan–Korea Forum for Communicable Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.with: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID, now JIHS); Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
nphi.summary: Tripartite mechanism of the three national disease-control institutes for academic exchange and information sharing on communicable disease control, hosted in rotation (15th forum online 2021, 17th in Seoul 2023).

nphi.title: Japan–China–Korea Forum for Communicable Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.with: NIID / NCGM (Japan Institute for Health Security), Japan; KDCA, South Korea
nphi.summary: Trilateral annual forum and joint symposium of the three countries' national disease control institutes, held in rotation. The 18th edition (Tokyo, 2024) covered post-COVID epidemiology, climate and health, and hepatitis/STIs.

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: KDCA – US CDC – IANPHI Asia-Pacific pandemic surveillance capacity workshop
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA, host); IANPHI; ECDC; UKHSA; ACPHEED; health authorities of 10 Asia-Pacific countries
nphi.summary: KDCA, US CDC and IANPHI co-hosted a workshop in Seoul in July 2025 for about 40 officials from 10 Asia-Pacific countries, plus ECDC, UKHSA and ACPHEED, to share surveillance data practices and strengthen pandemic surveillance cooperation.

nphi.title: KDCA-run GOARN tiered training for Korean responders (2024)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: GOARN (WHO); University of Western Australia; National Medical Center Korea
nphi.summary: KDCA held a multi-tier GOARN training programme from March 2024 in Seoul for 33 KDCA and National Medical Center staff, facilitated with a University of Western Australia expert; KDCA is a GOARN partner but had made no deployments by 2024.

nphi.title: KDCA – IVI – Africa CDC vaccine access side event, 2024 Korea-Africa Summit
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: Africa CDC; International Vaccine Institute
nphi.summary: Seoul side event where KDCA, IVI and Africa CDC committed to work on vaccines for emerging diseases and public-private partnerships towards the African Union goal of 60% local vaccine manufacturing by 2040.

nphi.title: UKHSA–KDCA memorandum of understanding on health security
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.summary: MoU covering preparedness and response, VHF outbreak monitoring, laboratory capacity, AMR and IPC, immunisation policy, pathogen data sharing and staff exchanges.

nphi.title: Philippine DOH study visit to KDCA ahead of creating a Philippine CDC
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: Department of Health, Philippines
nphi.summary: The Philippine health OIC visited KDCA in 2022 to learn from its model in preparation for establishing a Philippine Center for Disease Control and Prevention.

nphi.title: KDCA – IVI MoU, core funding and EPIC Fellowship
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (IVI)
nphi.summary: KDCA renewed annual core funding to IVI and agreed joint research, training and an EPIC fellowship training Korean epidemiologists for fieldwork in Africa and Asia.

nphi.title: China CDC – ASEAN (Plus Three) public health emergency tabletop exercises
nphi.with: National health authorities of ASEAN member states; ASEAN Secretariat; Malaysia NIH Biobank; Singapore public health laboratory
nphi.summary: A series of online workshops and tabletop exercises for ASEAN health authorities: health emergency response under ASEAN+3 (2021), IT-supported outbreak investigation (2022), and preservation and use of pathogen resources (2025).

nphi.title: Colombia accession to the International Vaccine Institute
nphi.actor: Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social de Colombia
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (IVI), Seoul; Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia (supporting)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Seoul in August 2021 for Colombia to join IVI, with work on COVID-19, dengue and chikungunya vaccine research and plans for local vaccine production, supported by INS Colombia.

nphi.title: KOICA – Africa CDC African Union COVID-19 emergency support project
nphi.with: Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA)
nphi.summary: KOICA and Africa CDC agreed a continent-wide project supplying treatment and diagnostic equipment and infection-prevention training, implemented with UNOPS.

nphi.title: KOICA–US CDC Cambodia infectious disease control programme, phase 2 (2020–2025)
nphi.with: KOICA; Cambodia Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: US$8.5 million second phase to improve laboratory biosafety, emergency response systems and training of epidemiologists in Cambodia.

nphi.title: Korea–Saudi framework of cooperation, including advice on establishing a Saudi disease control centre
nphi.actor: Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (KCDC)
nphi.with: Saudi Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: After MERS, South Korea's health ministry and KCDC agreed in 2016 to advise Saudi Arabia on setting up a CDC, train Saudi health staff, and share information on emerging infections such as MERS and Zika.

nphi.title: China CDC–KDCA memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA, formerly KCDC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2004 and renewed in 2019 on emergency preparedness, emerging infectious disease monitoring, joint research, staff exchange and training.

nphi.title: China–Japan–Korea Forum on Communicable Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.with: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), Japan; Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
nphi.summary: Tripartite mechanism of the three national CDCs for scientific exchange and information sharing on communicable diseases, hosted in rotation; the 15th forum was held online in 2021.
